Overview.Purpose: Defines dataclass genes used to describe reusable genotype node types and directed child connections.
Main_Use_Cases: Represent symbolic body-part nodes before MuJoCo XML generation
Represent directed connections between node genes
Store genetic Euler orientations for root and child bodies
Store motor control parameters on each connection

ConnectionGene.Purpose: Describes how a parent genotype node attaches and orients a child node plus the generated actuator parameters.

Constructor.Signature: ConnectionGene(child: str, axis: Tuple[float, float, float], name: str = "", parent_face: str = "+x", ...)

child.Description: Name of the child node in Genotype.nodes.

parent_face.Description: Parent box face containing the child hinge and attachment point.

surface_uv.Description: Normalized coordinates from -1 to 1 along the two remaining axes in X/Y/Z order.

orientation.Description: Child body Euler orientation in degrees relative to the parent body. The rotated child local +X axis must point within 90 degrees of the selected parent face normal.

symmetry.Description: Any subset of xy, xz, and yz; each selected plane doubles the mirrored child subtree.

axis.Description: Joint or actuator axis; translation for slide and rotation/torque for hinge or ball.

scale.Description: Scales child size by scale ** (order - 1) for this connection along each hierarchy path; symmetry siblings with one parent share an order.

terminal_only.Description: Creates the child only at the terminal occurrence of the parent node; cannot be enabled on a self-pointing connection.

motor_enabled.Description: Whether this connection receives a generated MuJoCo motor.

motor_gear.Description: Motor gear value written to the MJCF actuator.

ctrlrange.Description: Control range for the generated motor.

control_amp.Description: Amplitude for the sine-wave open-loop controller.

control_freq.Description: Harmonic multiplier applied to Genotype.global_control_freq for the sine-wave controller.

control_phase.Description: Base phase offset for the sine-wave open-loop controller.

control_phase_depth_scale.Description: Additional phase offset multiplied by recursive depth.

control_phase_order_scale.Description: Additional phase offset multiplied by actuator order.

neural_output_axes.Description: Signed physical axis associated with each neural output row.

surface_uv.Description: Normalized coordinates on the selected face.

orientation.Description: Relative child body Euler orientation in degrees, validated against the parent attachment normal.

axis.Description: Joint or actuator axis for the connection.

scale.Description: Hierarchy scaling factor applied as scale ** (order - 1).

terminal_only.Description: Whether the child is emitted only on the terminal parent occurrence.

motor_enabled.Description: Whether to create a motor for the generated articulated joint.

neural_output_axes.Description: Signed physical axes associated with neural output rows.

phase_for.Purpose: Compute the controller phase after depth and actuator-order offsets are applied.

depth.Description: Recursive node depth for the generated body.

order.Description: Zero-based order of the generated actuator.

NodeGene.Purpose: Describes one reusable body-part type in the genotype graph, including the optional root-body orientation.

Constructor.Signature: NodeGene(name: str, size: Tuple[float, float, float], joint_type: str = "hinge", recursive_limit: int = 1, child_connections: List[str] | None = None, orientation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), shape: str = "box")

size.Description: Local bounding half extents for generated geometry. Capsules and cylinders use local X as the main axis and normalize Y/Z to the same circular radius.

joint_type.Description: Joint type for generated body: "free", "hinge", "slide", or "ball".

recursive_limit.Description: Maximum number of this node type along one recursive expansion path.

child_connections.Description: Ordered connection-gene names expanded beneath generated bodies of this type.

orientation.Description: Euler orientation in degrees. Only the root node orientation is used as the root body world-relative orientation.
Euler orientation in degrees; used for the generated root body when this node is the genotype root.

NodeGene.Example: node = NodeGene(name="body", size=(0.15, 0.08, 0.06), joint_type="free", orientation=(0.0, 0.0, 15.0), shape="ellipsoid")

child_orientation_is_valid.Signature: child_orientation_is_valid(parent_face: str, orientation: Tuple[float, float, float]) -> bool
child_orientation_is_valid.Purpose: Return whether a child orientation keeps the child local +X axis within 90 degrees of the selected parent face normal.

Returns.Description: True when the orientation satisfies the child-normal constraint.

euler_degrees_to_matrix.Signature: euler_degrees_to_matrix(orientation: Tuple[float, float, float]) -> Tuple[Tuple[float, float, float], ...]
euler_degrees_to_matrix.Purpose: Convert roll, pitch, yaw Euler angles in degrees to the rotation matrix used for genotype orientation checks and MJCF quaternion generation.

Overview.Purpose: Defines the top-level genotype dataclass that combines active genes with archived genetic material and mutation behavior.
Main_Use_Cases: Store the root node and active NodeGene mapping
Carry archived nodes and connections used by topology mutations
Expose mutation behavior through GenotypeMutationMixin

Genotype.Purpose: Stores a genotype graph recipe plus archived genetic material for mutation reuse.

Constructor.Signature: Genotype(root: str, nodes: Dict[str, NodeGene], connections: Dict[str, ConnectionGene], global_control_freq: float = 1.0, control_mode: str = "neural", archived_connections: Dict[str, ConnectionGene] = field(default_factory=dict), archived_nodes: Dict[str, NodeGene] = field(default_factory=dict))

root.Description: Name of the node where phenotype expansion begins.

nodes.Description: Active node genes keyed by node name.

connections.Description: Active connection genes keyed by connection name.

global_control_freq.Description: Continuous base angular frequency multiplied by each connection control_freq harmonic.

control_mode.Description: Global controller family for the genotype: neural or sine.

archived_connections.Description: Inactive named connection genes retained as mutation templates.

archived_nodes.Description: Inactive named node genes retained as mutation templates.

global_control_freq.Description: Continuous base actuator frequency shared by all generated controllers.

control_mode.Description: Global controller family used when building controllers.

mutation.Signature: mutation(num_mutations: int = 1, mutation_rate: Optional[float] = None, rng: Optional[random.Random] = None, allow_topology_mutations: bool = True) -> Genotype
mutation.Purpose: Inherited from GenotypeMutationMixin; mutates genotype parameters in place and returns the same object.

num_mutations.Description: Number of distinct mutable parameters to sample when mutation_rate is not provided.

mutation_rate.Description: Independent mutation probability for every mutable parameter; overrides num_mutations when provided.

rng.Description: Random source for reproducible mutation sequences.

allow_topology_mutations.Description: Whether to allow connection and node topology changes.

Returns.Description: The same genotype object after in-place mutation.

Overview.Purpose: Builds, loads, saves, and serializes genotype graph recipes using the project JSON schema.
Main_Use_Cases: Construct Genotype objects from compact mapping specs
Load genotype recipes from JSON files
Save active and archived genetic material back to JSON

build_genotype.Signature: build_genotype(root: str, nodes: GeneSpec, connections: GeneSpec, global_control_freq: float = 1.0, control_mode: str = "neural") -> Genotype
build_genotype.Purpose: Build a concrete Genotype from normalized node and connection mappings.

nodes.Description: Mapping from node names to node fields and child_connections lists.

connections.Description: Mapping from connection names to connection fields.

global_control_freq.Description: Continuous base actuator frequency for the returned genotype.

control_mode.Description: Global controller family for the returned genotype.

Returns.Description: A genotype with NodeGene and ConnectionGene objects linked according to spec.

load_genotype_from_json.Purpose: Load the normalized genotype JSON schema with named active and archived gene maps.

path.Description: Path to a genotype JSON file.

save_genotype_to_json.Signature: save_genotype_to_json(genotype: Genotype, path: str | Path) -> None
save_genotype_to_json.Purpose: Save a genotype recipe to JSON, including archived genetic material.

path.Description: Output JSON path; parent directories are created automatically.

genotype_to_dict.Purpose: Convert a Genotype object into the JSON-compatible recipe shape used by this project.

Returns.Description: Dictionary with root, nodes, archived_connections, and archived_nodes.

Overview.Purpose: Implements parameter and topology mutation behavior mixed into Genotype.
Main_Use_Cases: Mutate numeric, boolean, and tuple-valued genotype fields
Add, remove, replace, and retarget genotype connections
Create new mutated node genes and archive disconnected genetic material

GenotypeMutationMixin.Purpose: Mixin that provides in-place genotype mutation methods and helper routines.

MUTATION_STD_FRACTION.Description: Fraction of a numeric value used as the default mutation standard deviation.

MIN_SIZE_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for size mutations.

MIN_AXIS_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for axis mutations.

MIN_INTEGER_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for integer mutations.

MIN_POS_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for position mutations.

MIN_SCALE_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for scale mutations.

MIN_MOTOR_GEAR_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for motor gear mutations.

MIN_CTRLRANGE_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for control range mutations.

MIN_CONTROL_AMP_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for control amplitude mutations.

MIN_GLOBAL_CONTROL_FREQ_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for global control frequency mutations.

MIN_PHASE_MUTATION_STD.Description: Minimum standard deviation for phase mutations.

MIN_POSITIVE_VALUE.Description: Lower clamp used for positive-valued mutations.

mutation.Signature: mutation(num_mutations: int = 1, mutation_rate: Optional[float] = None, rng: Optional[random.Random] = None, allow_topology_mutations: bool = True) -> Genotype
mutation.Purpose: Randomly mutate mutable genotype parameters in place.

num_mutations.Description: Number of distinct mutable parameters sampled when mutation_rate is None.

mutation_rate.Description: Independent probability applied to every mutable parameter.

rng.Description: Random source; defaults to the random module.

allow_topology_mutations.Description: Whether topology-changing mutation paths are included.

Internal_Methods._collect_mutable_parameters: Collects tuple paths for all mutable fields and optional topology operations.
Internal_Methods._add_mutable_parameter_paths: Adds scalar or per-element tuple/list mutation paths for one field.
Internal_Methods._mutate_parameter_path: Dispatches one selected mutation path to the appropriate mutation operation.
Internal_Methods._describe_parameter_target: Builds human-readable labels for mutation logging.
Internal_Methods._resolve_parameter_path: Resolves a mutation path to the owner object, field name, and optional index.
Internal_Methods._path_index: Returns the optional tuple/list index from a mutation path.
Internal_Methods._mutation_spec: Maps field names to mutation kind, minimum standard deviation, and ordered-pair behavior.
Internal_Methods._mutate_value: Mutates boolean, integer, positive, and relative numeric values.
Internal_Methods._normal_mutation_delta: Draws a Gaussian mutation delta with a minimum standard deviation.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_origin: Moves a connection to a different origin node.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_destination: Changes a connection child to another non-free node.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_type: Copies connection parameters from another active or archived connection.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_replacement: Archives a connection and replaces it with a mutated copy.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_addition: Adds a new connection between active or archived node templates.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_new_node_addition: Creates a new mutated node and connects it to an existing origin.
Internal_Methods._add_new_connection: Creates and attaches a new connection from a template or default coding.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_removal: Archives and removes an active connection.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_origin_node_replaceme: Creates a mutated replacement for the origin node of a connection.
Internal_Methods._mutate_connection_destination_node_repl: Creates a mutated replacement for the destination node of a connection.
Internal_Methods._new_node_from_existing: Deep-copies a node and assigns a new mutation-derived name.
Internal_Methods._new_node_name: Finds an unused name of the form '<base>_mutN'.
Internal_Methods._mutate_new_node: Mutates one field on a newly created node.
Internal_Methods._resolve_new_node_path: Resolves a mutation path for a new node.
Internal_Methods._mutate_new_connection: Mutates one field on a newly created connection.
Internal_Methods._connection_coding_pool: Returns active and archived connections as templates.
Internal_Methods._random_connection_template: Chooses a connection template or returns None when none exist.
Internal_Methods._node_coding_pool: Returns active and archived nodes as templates.
Internal_Methods._activate_node_gene: Moves an archived node template into active nodes, recursively activating archived children when needed.
Internal_Methods._find_archived_node: Finds the most recently archived node by name.
Internal_Methods._prune_disconnected_nodes: Archives and removes nodes unreachable from the genotype root.
Internal_Methods._reachable_node_names: Computes active node names reachable from the root.
Internal_Methods._describe_connection_source: Builds human-readable labels for active or archived connection templates.
Internal_Methods._is_active_connection: Checks whether a connection object is attached to an active node.
Internal_Methods._archived_connection_index: Finds the archive index for a connection object.
Internal_Methods._find_connection_owner: Finds the active origin node and child index for a connection object.

ValueError.Description: Raised by mutation when mutation_rate is outside [0, 1], num_mutations is negative, or an unknown mutation path/kind is encountered.

Overview.Purpose: Validates recursive genotype graphs and estimates expanded phenotype size before XML generation.
Main_Use_Cases: Reject invalid roots or child references before phenotype build
Reject invalid recursion limits and unbounded recursive loops
Abort expansion before max_node would be exceeded

PhenotypeBuildAbort.Purpose: Base runtime error for failures that should prevent phenotype expansion.

PhenotypeNodeLimitExceeded.Purpose: Signals that genotype expansion would exceed the configured phenotype node budget.
PhenotypeNodeLimitExceeded.Example: raise PhenotypeNodeLimitExceeded("Maximum allowed number of phenotype nodes exceeded")

GenotypeGraphError.Purpose: Signals invalid genotype graph structure such as unknown children, bad recursion limits, or unbounded recursion.

GenotypeGraphAnalyzer.Purpose: Counts bounded genotype graph expansion and validates structure before MuJoCo XML is built.

memoized_counts.Description: Cache of expansion counts by node/depth state.

active_states.Description: States currently on the recursion stack.

validate.Purpose: Validate graph structure and return exact expanded node count when within budget.

Internal_Methods._validate_recursive_limits: Ensures every node recursive_limit is a positive integer and not a bool.
Internal_Methods._count_expanded_nodes: Recursively counts expanded nodes with memoization and cycle detection.

PhenotypeBuildAbort.Description: Base class for phenotype build aborts.

PhenotypeNodeLimitExceeded.Description: Raised when graph analysis or XML creation exceeds max_node.

GenotypeGraphError.Description: Raised for invalid genotype roots, child references, recursion limits, or unbounded recursive loops.

ValueError.Description: Raised when max_node is less than 1.

Overview.Purpose: Automatically discovers task modules. Each task-specific submodule defines and registers its config, result type, metadata, and evaluator; shared MuJoCo rollout mechanics live in evolution_tasks.shared.
Main_Use_Cases: Evaluate a genotype's task-specific locomotion fitness
Return diagnostics such as distance, drift, energy, angular speed, and body count
Convert phenotype build failures or unstable simulations into failed evaluation results

SwimmingEvaluationConfig.Purpose: Frozen dataclass of simulation settings and fitness weights for x-axis swimming.

Constructor.Signature: SwimmingEvaluationConfig(episode_seconds: float = 10.0, max_node: int = 500, self_collision: bool = false, disallow_collision: bool = false, target_direction: Sequence[float] = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), forward_speed_weight: float = 1.0, energy_weight: float = 0.001, sideways_drift_weight: float = 0.1, vertical_drift_weight: float = 0.1, angular_speed_weight: float = 0.01, body_count_weight: float = 0.001, volume_weight: float = 0.01, volume_penalty_cutoff: float = 0.1, max_volume: float = 1.0, build_failure_fitness: float = -1000.0, max_abs_state_value: float = 1000000.0, max_abs_velocity: float = 1000.0, max_abs_acceleration: float = 100000.0)

max_node.Description: Phenotype node budget used by PhenotypeBuilder.

self_collision.Description: Enable collision between non-parent creature bodies.

disallow_collision.Description: Assign failure fitness when a non-parent collision occurs.

target_direction.Description: Direction used to measure forward progress.

forward_speed_weight.Description: Reward multiplier for average forward speed.

body_count_weight.Description: Penalty multiplier for generated body count.

volume_weight.Description: Linear penalty multiplier for volume above volume_penalty_cutoff.

volume_penalty_cutoff.Description: Generated volume in cubic meters allowed without a volume penalty.

max_volume.Description: Hard maximum generated creature volume in cubic meters; larger phenotypes receive failure fitness.

build_failure_fitness.Description: Fitness assigned when build or simulation fails.

max_abs_state_value.Description: Position/state magnitude threshold used to detect numerical instability.

max_abs_velocity.Description: Absolute generalized-velocity limit used to reject unstable simulations.

max_abs_acceleration.Description: Absolute generalized-acceleration limit used to reject unstable simulations before MuJoCo resets state.

self_collision.Description: Whether non-parent creature bodies can collide.

disallow_collision.Description: Whether non-parent collisions disqualify the evaluation.

SwimmingEvaluationResult.Purpose: Frozen dataclass containing final fitness and diagnostic metrics.

Constructor.Signature: SwimmingEvaluationResult(fitness: float, forward_distance: float, average_forward_speed: float, sideways_drift_speed: float, vertical_drift_speed: float, control_energy: float, mean_angular_speed: float, simulated_seconds: float, actuator_count: int, body_count: int, total_volume: float, build_failed: bool = False, disqualified: bool = False, failure_reason: str | None = None)

average_forward_speed.Description: Forward distance divided by simulated seconds.

sideways_drift_speed.Description: Absolute y-axis lateral drift divided by simulated seconds.

vertical_drift_speed.Description: Absolute z-axis displacement divided by simulated seconds.

body_count.Description: Number of generated bodies excluding world.

disqualified.Description: Whether a prohibited non-parent collision assigned failure fitness.

failure_reason.Description: Failure detail when build_failed is True.

control_energy.Description: Gear-aware integrated squared joint effort metric.
